name: Mangal Ooti
instructions: 1. Soak the dry peas overnight and drain well. 2. Heat mustard oil in a pan and sauté the onions, ginger, garlic, and green chilies until fragrant. 3. Add the soaked peas and fresh peas to the pan and stir-fry for a few minutes. 4. Add water, salt, and the pinch of bicarbonate of soda, then cover and simmer until the peas are soft and the gravy thickens. 5. Mash a few peas slightly to thicken the consistency. 6. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with steamed rice.
description: Mangal Ooti is a classic Manipuri comfort food often served during traditional feasts and daily meals. It is valued for its simple yet nutritious profile and represents the local culinary reliance on pulses and fresh vegetables.
